operations: Add failing workflow tests for ordered phases and finite rework.
Enforce state-aligned transitions and gates without changing Android production code.
Clarify Planner, Tester, Builder, Reviewer, and coordinator handoffs.
planner.rollback: Restore only BT-019-owned workflow, agent-contract, task, template, test, and evidence files; do not touch Android source or earlier task evidence.

securityPreflight.scope: BT-019 workflow control plane only: finite state transitions, additive phase-aware gates, bounded owner-classified rework, workflow tests, handoff templates/docs, and the four custom agent contracts. Excludes Android/product code, data, dependencies, CI, credentials, external writes, destructive actions, and unrelated refactors.

findings.description: Run gates before atomic state writes; failed gates leave the prior state unchanged. Preserve all existing dependency, spec, red-test, preflight, destructive-approval, verification, and review checks.
Existing done evidence may omit new control fields, but active tasks fail closed. Accepted preimplementation red evidence is immutable and Builder cannot edit tests or the plan.
Coordinator owns failure classification and stable human-readable keys. One repair is allowed; the second identical unresolved failure blocks without automatic retry.

red.observedFailure: Genuine red: Ran 22 tests; FAILED (failures=16, errors=12). Missing red/implement/verify/review/rework actions; done skips review; gates ignore active phase/control fields; finite rework, foundation acceptance coverage, and Tester/Builder independence are unenforced.

reworkRed.observedFailure: Genuine RED: 25 tests ran; 3 failures. Actual BT-005 completed evidence was rejected by check-done; simulated second file replacement failure left queue/evidence phases inconsistent; recurrence of a stable failure key after passed verify/review was blocked instead of routed to implementing.

verification.command: Parse workflow/tasks.json, workflow/evidence/BT-019.json, workflow/templates/handoff.json, and all .codex/agents/*.toml files

findings.description: Completed legacy BT-005 evidence fails check-done because acceptance coverage is required only in tester.red.acceptanceIds, although earlier test revisions recorded the covered IDs. Add compatibility coverage for actual BT-005 evidence and preserve active-task checks.

Two-file transition persistence can leave evidence and queue out of sync if evidence replacement succeeds and queue replacement fails. Add rollback and a regression test for a failure between replacements.

Rework history treats any second occurrence of a key as unresolved even after a successful verification. Resolve failures only after a passing verification/review and allow a later recurrence to start a new repair cycle.
